name: Wildixir
storyline: Corruption has spread across three enchanted lands. Alchemists venture into the Enchanted Forest, the marsh, and the Glass Ruins to cleanse shrines and confront the creatures that inhabit them. Through alchemy, restored shrines can become healing groves or deadly gardens, turning the land itself into an ally against the corruption.
summary: Wildixir is a single-player action roguelite set in enchanted lands. Combine automatic weapons and alchemical reactions, restore shrines, and face each region's boss. Between runs, spend seeds on permanent upgrades and unlock new characters and locations.
